C-APPROVAL-FINGERPRINT.Summary: gate approve becomes the sanctioned writer of draft to approved on the targeted spec or plan, and records on that permitting Decision a per-Decision fingerprint of the artifact bytes it just wrote, plus an artifact attribute naming spec or plan. Review classifies an approved spec or plan three ways: no permitting approve Decision at all is an error (never asked); a Decision whose fingerprint does not match the current bytes is an error (contract drifted); a Decision carrying no fingerprint is silent (approved before the writer existed). This bundle re-sources approved-contract-drift from those records, with the existing git tracked-changed reading as fallback, and keeps the state name and hard-stop message. A forced permit records itself as forced with an operator-supplied reason. Tamper-evidence, not enforcement.
